definitions: To be involved in many different activities or businesses, often to the point of being overextended or interfering.
To have an interest or influence in a wide variety of matters.
examples: She has fingers in every pie at the company, from marketing to product development.
He likes to have fingers in every pie, so he's always aware of what's happening.
It's hard to focus when you have fingers in every pie.
synonyms: have a finger in every pie
